comment: Shipped analysis profiles. A profile is 'how I analyze this kind of case' — the plugins to enable, an optional starter watchlist, and a dashboard of widgets. SQL widgets use {{evtx}} / {{header_set:Name}} placeholders that bind to whichever table matches that header set in the open case (and {{all:header_set:Name}} unions every matching table, for logs split across many files), so the dashboard is portable. Shipped profiles are read-only; Save-as-profile creates editable copies. A profile may also declare `variables`: [{name, label?, description?, required?, default?}] — case variables it seeds on apply (never overwriting a value the analyst set); required ones are asked for in the new-case dialog and after applying to an existing case. Definitions only, never values. A profile may carry extra named boards under `dashboards`: [{name, widgets}] — applied alongside `dashboard` (which keeps the profile's own name), each upserted by its own name. A widget's results are cached in the case file and painted on open with their age; `"live": true` marks a widget that re-runs on every open instead — for the cheap ones whose number has to be current the moment the board appears (the watchlist and tag counts here), never for a GROUP BY over the whole log. Everything else is re-run by ↻ Refresh. A widget may also be a GRID of labelled numbers rather than one: `"render": "signals"` with `"source": "cells"` and `"cells": [{label, source, query, drill, tone?, chip?}]`, where every cell keeps its own drill — so a card can carry eleven numbers without collapsing eleven drill-throughs into one. A cell's label is unique within its card (it is how the drill is found), `chip: true` draws it as a yes/no pill above the numbers, one card is one request whatever the cell count, and a cell whose table is missing from the case reports in its own place instead of taking the card down. A widget that legitimately finds nothing answers with NO ROWS — never a sentinel row saying so: the board folds an empty card into a one-line strip at the top that says whether the artefact is missing from the case (import one) or the table is here and the query matched nothing, and a card carrying a "(no …)" row of its own looks full and cannot be folded. Each profile carries a `version`: bump it whenever a shipped profile's contents change. A copy made with “Copy to edit” records the profile it came from and the version it was taken at, and the profile manager then offers the diff — and a button to take the update — when the shipped one is newer. Nothing is ever rewritten automatically. One profile also exports to a single `winnow-profile/1` file (format, profile) carrying exactly these keys, minus the id and the shipped flag.

profiles.name: KAPE triage
profiles.description: Windows host triage from KAPE/EvtxECmd output — logon movement, failed-logon spikes, RDP and explicit-credential use, log-tampering signals, and (if a RECmd batch is imported) host facts from the registry — OS version, role, domain, IPs, Sysmon and PowerShell logging posture — plus registry persistence. Seeds a starter IOC watchlist.

query.sql: SELECT k, v FROM (SELECT 10 AS ord, 'Computer name' AS k, ValueData AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Control\ComputerName\ComputerName' AND ValueName = 'ComputerName' AND ValueData <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'Hostname (TCP/IP)', ValueData FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Services\Tcpip\Parameters' AND ValueName = 'Hostname' AND ValueData <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 20 + CASE ValueName WHEN 'DhcpIPAddress' THEN 0 WHEN 'IPAddress' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE ValueName WHEN 'DhcpIPAddress' THEN 'IP (DHCP)' WHEN 'IPAddress' THEN 'IP (static)' ELSE 'Gateway' END, ValueData FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\%' AND ValueName IN ('DhcpIPAddress','IPAddress','DhcpDefaultGateway') AND ValueData NOT IN ('','0.0.0.0') UNION ALL SELECT 30 + CASE ValueName WHEN 'Domain' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ValueName, CASE WHEN ValueData = '' THEN '(none — workgroup)' ELSE ValueData END FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Services\Tcpip\Parameters' AND ValueName IN ('Domain','NV Domain') UNION ALL SELECT 40 + CASE ValueName WHEN 'ProductName' THEN 0 WHEN 'DisplayVersion' THEN 1 WHEN 'ReleaseId' THEN 2 WHEN 'CurrentBuild' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, ValueName, ValueData FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' AND ValueName IN ('ProductName','DisplayVersion','ReleaseId','CurrentBuild','UBR') AND ValueData <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'Function', CASE ValueData WHEN 'WinNT' THEN 'Workstation' WHEN 'ServerNT' THEN 'Member / standalone server' WHEN 'LanmanNT' THEN 'Domain controller' ELSE ValueData END FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Control\ProductOptions' AND ValueName = 'ProductType' AND ValueData <> '' ORDER BY ord)

dashboard.title: Logging posture
dashboard.sub: service and policy keys, and what was tampered with

query.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%\Services\Sysmon%' AND ValueName = 'ImagePath'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%\Services\SysmonDrv%'

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ValueData IN ('1','0x1') FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging' AND ValueName = 'EnableScriptBlockLogging' LIMIT 1), 0)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ValueData IN ('1','0x1') FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ModuleLogging' AND ValueName = 'EnableModuleLogging' LIMIT 1), 0)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ValueData IN ('1','0x1') FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\Transcription' AND ValueName = 'EnableTranscripting' LIMIT 1), 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='1102'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='4719'

SELECT 'Security: oldest' AS k, COALESCE(MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)), '(no Security channel events)') AS v FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel = 'Security' AND TimeCreated <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'Security: newest', COALESCE(MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)), '') FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel = 'Security' AND TimeCreated <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'Security: span (days)', COALESCE(ROUND(julianday(MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated))) - julianday(MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated))), 1), '') FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel = 'Security' AND TimeCreated <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'Security: events', COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel = 'Security' UNION ALL SELECT 'All channels: window', CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '(no timestamps)' WHEN substr(MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)), 1, 10) = substr(MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)), 1, 10) THEN MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) || ' → ' || substr(MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)), 12) ELSE MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) || ' → ' || MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) END FROM {{evtx}} WHERE TimeCreated <> ''
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Computer) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Computer NOT IN ('','-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserName) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE UserName NOT IN ('','-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteHost) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='4624' AND RemoteHost NOT IN ('-','','- (-)')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='4625'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='4648'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel LIKE '%TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager%' AND EventId IN ('21','24','25')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' AND EventId = '4104'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel = 'Security' AND EventId = '4688'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%\Run' OR KeyPath LIKE '%\RunOnce' OR KeyPath LIKE '%\Services%' OR Category LIKE '%Run%' OR Category LIKE '%Service%'

dashboard.title: Findings
dashboard.sub: your own marks on the case

query.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) AS hr, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId IN ('4624','4625','4648') AND TimeCreated <> '' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr
SELECT RemoteHost, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='4624' AND RemoteHost NOT IN ('-','','- (-)') GROUP BY RemoteHost ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT UserName, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId='4624' AND UserName <> '' GROUP BY UserName ORDER BY c ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT Category AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{registry}} WHERE Category NOT IN ('','-') GROUP BY Category ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM (SELECT TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated) AS k, EventId || ' · ' || CASE WHEN MapDescription <> '' THEN MapDescription ELSE PayloadData1 END AS v FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Provider LIKE '%Windows Defender%' AND EventId IN ('1006','1007','1008','1009','1010','1011','1012','1015','1116','1117','1118','1119','5001','5004','5007','5010','5012') ORDER BY TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated) DESC LIMIT 8)

profiles.name: ESXi / UAC triage
profiles.description: VMware ESXi support-bundle and UAC Linux host-log triage — one overview of every parsed log (hostd, vmkernel, auth, shell, vobd, vpxa, syslog, rhttpproxy, esxupdate): SSH and sudo activity with source IPs, shell commands, VM power and snapshot operations, vCenter-initiated actions, account/lockdown/firewall changes, and VIB install/remove. Enable the esxi_logs plugin and import the bundle (Winnow expands the archive).

query.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}}
SELECT Log AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} GROUP BY Log ORDER BY c DESC

SELECT 'First' AS k, MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(Timestamp)) AS v FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Timestamp <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'Last', MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(Timestamp)) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Timestamp <> ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='auth' AND Message LIKE '%Accepted%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='auth' AND (Message LIKE '%Failed%' OR Message LIKE '%authentication failure%' OR Message LIKE '%Invalid user%')
SELECT SourceIP AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE SourceIP <> '' GROUP BY SourceIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Component IN ('sudo','su') OR Message LIKE '%sudo:%' OR Message LIKE '% su[%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='shell'
SELECT Message, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='shell' AND Message <> '' GROUP BY Message ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='hostd' AND (Message LIKE '%power%' OR Message LIKE '%PowerOn%' OR Message LIKE '%PowerOff%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='hostd' AND Message LIKE '%snapshot%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='vpxa'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='vobd' AND (Message LIKE '%account%' OR Message LIKE '%lockdown%' OR Message LIKE '%firewall%' OR Message LIKE '%Account%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='esxupdate'
SELECT SourceIP AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='rhttpproxy' AND SourceIP <> '' GROUP BY SourceIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Severity AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} GROUP BY Severity ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', TS_NORMALIZE(Timestamp)) AS hr, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Timestamp <> '' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr
